name: Fairy Gold
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
This small, round wooden carving typically carries the emblem or calling card of the trickster who created it. When activated, the token multiplies into a stack of mixed coins worth 25 gp (usually 10 cp, 9 sp, and 24 gp). The coins appear real, though a close investigation with a successful DC 20 Perception check check to disbelieve the illusion reveals that they are subtle forgeries. At the next dawn, the coins disappear, leaving behind tiny honey or ginger cakes surrounded by flower blossoms, cactus needles, or other worthless materials symbolic to the trickster.
